metadata.title: The Woman Fixing a Microsoft Mess With Brutal Honesty - WSJ

content.text:
REDMOND, Wash.—Asha Sharma had zero experience in videogames when Microsoft MSFT 0.65%increase; up pointing triangle put her in charge of cleaning up its Xbox business.
Her approach has been to aggressively share bad news.
